description:
Ask for an asset Better Design does not make yet, such as a whitepaper, a flyer, a case study or a banner. Call it when the person asks for a format that make-slides, make-sales-page and make-social-image do not cover. Pass the format in the person's words and their brief.

Better Design saves the request and emails the team's designer, the owner of the person's workspace. The answer names the closest asset Better Design makes, if one comes close, so you can make that now as a stand-in. It spends no credits.

brief.description: What the person wants in it: the audience, the message, the facts to use and any deadline.

format.description: The kind of asset the person asked for, in their words, for example "whitepaper", "flyer" or "case study".

projectId.description: The projectId create-design-system returned for the team's own brand. The asset uses that brand's colours and type. Pass this or designSystemId.

name: request-asset
title: Request an Asset
